integrations.description: Analytics providers and the c15t consent banner for the live site. Notra installs their scripts automatically. Preview deployments and local development do not send provider events.

measurementId.description: Google Analytics 4 web stream Measurement ID (G-…). Find it in Admin > Data streams > your web stream.

domain.description: Site domain registered in Plausible, without https:// (e.g. docs.acme.com).

server.description: Self-hosted Plausible hostname with an optional port, without https://. Omit to use plausible.io.

apiKey.description: Public PostHog project API key (phc_…), not a personal API key.

apiHost.description: PostHog ingestion URL. Defaults to https://us.i.posthog.com; use https://eu.i.posthog.com for EU Cloud or your self-hosted HTTPS endpoint.

sessionRecording.description: Enable session recording (default: true). Authorize your site domain in PostHog project settings. Set false to keep analytics without recordings.

websiteId.description: Public Umami Website ID (UUID) from your website's Tracking code. No API key is needed.

scriptUrl.description: Tracker script URL including a non-root path. Defaults to https://cloud.umami.is/script.js; use your self-hosted HTTPS script URL when needed.

hostUrl.description: Optional collection endpoint base URL (data-host-url). Only needed when events should go to a different endpoint, such as a reverse proxy.

backendURL.description: Your Inth project URL (https://your-project.inth.app) or the URL of your self-hosted c15t backend, including any path prefix. Visitors save consent there.

gateAnalytics.description: Load the analytics providers in integrations only after the visitor allows the measurement category (default: true). Set false to load them on every page view, outside the consent banner.

direction.description: Lay the buttons out in a row (default) or a column.

uiProfile.description: compact (default) sizes buttons to their labels; balanced and strict stretch every button to full width.

prompt.description: Shape and position of the consent banner. floating is a card, bar spans the viewport edge, widget is a compact corner card, wall blocks the page until the visitor chooses.

preferences.description: Layout of the privacy settings dialog.

blocking.description: Dim the page and trap focus while open (default: true).

direction.description: Lay the buttons out in a row (default) or a column.

uiProfile.description: compact (default) sizes buttons to their labels; balanced and strict stretch every button to full width.

legalLinks.description: Legal pages linked from the banner and the dialog.

label.description: Link text. Defaults to the translated name of the link.
Link text. Defaults to the translated name of the link.
Link text. Defaults to the translated name of the link.

locale.description: Force the banner language. Omit to follow the visitor's browser language.

crossSubdomain.description: Share the consent cookie with every subdomain of the site's domain (default: false).

expiryDays.description: Days until the stored choice expires (default: 365).

disableAnimation.description: Show the banner and dialog without animations.

theme.description: Banner and dialog styling. By default they use your site's colors, fonts and dark mode.

colors.description: Light mode colors as hex values. Unset colors follow your site's theme.

dark.description: Dark mode colors as hex values. Unset colors follow your site's dark theme.

radius.description: Corner rounding of the banner, dialog and buttons (default: medium).

hideBranding.description: Hide the 'Secured by c15t' badge on the banner. Check that your Inth plan allows it.

devTools.description: Show the c15t DevTools panel during local development with notra-sites dev (default: true). Never included in previews or the live site.

c15t.description: c15t cookie banner and privacy settings, backed by Inth or your self-hosted c15t backend. Live deployments only; previews and local development show the banner without saving consent.

title: blog.json
description: Configuration of a Notra Sites blog and changelog. Every option except name is optional.
